tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Exponential growth bound for the minimal annulus area] ↗ prop:curve-deformation-existence

The least annulus area between two degree-one ramp flows grows at most exponentially, with exponent controlled by the ambient sectional-curvature bound and independent of $\lambda $.
Proof

\sketch Integrate Lemma 4.2.

□
